title: PR drafting resolves base scope and treats validation evidence conservatively

provenance.originSummary: Synthetic benchmark matrix for comparison-base, preflight, and validation-evidence behavior.
provenance.whyItMattered: A draft can be materially wrong if existing pull request scope hides local changes or if skipped and stale tests are reported as passing.
provenance.genericCondition: Sanitized runs combine existing pull request base metadata, local unpushed changes, unavailable authorities, service-scope conflict, and multiple validation evidence states.

description: A matrix covering authoritative base metadata plus local changes, required base source failure, unrelated service hard stop, and successful, skipped, missing, or stale validation evidence.

scope.notes: The fixture defines independent runs for base, preflight, scope-conflict, and validation-evidence decisions.

mustCatch.description: Existing pull request base metadata selects the base but does not replace committed, staged, unstaged, or untracked local evidence.
The selected base commit supplies the pull request template and contributor policy while the merge base is used only as the diff origin.
A missing required template or contributor guide at the merge base produces the exact named-source hard stop.
Unrelated primary changes in two service packages stop drafting before a title is guessed.
Only successful current-run applicable validation is reported as passing; skipped, missing, stale, and contradicted evidence remain unchecked and visible as gaps.

mustNotFlag.description: Existing pull request text must not erase local unpushed changes from scope.
A successful process exit with skipped acceptance tests must not check the local-test item without required environment evidence.

mustIncludeMarkers: Cannot run draft-pr-description: required base-revision source is missing:
Cannot run draft-pr-description: unrelated primary changes span multiple service packages.
No observed current-run local test evidence.
mustNotIncludeMarkers: Tests passed locally based on the existing pull request body.

notes: Each scenario is a separate prompt invocation; hard-stop scenarios intentionally do not emit the normal five-section output.
